ruling.recommended_action: Refund S$2.44 to the rider as a Ryde voucher for the unexcused detour segment; record the RD-1 breach on the driver's file (no account flag this time).

segment_findings.reason: Off-route segment 17:41-17:44 (1.76 km vs 0.03 km optimal, +1.73 km, max 979 m from route). Driver claims the Seletar Expressway accident [F9] and F12 corroborates an accident on the optimal route (0 m, reported 17:16, within window), so part of the early deviation is explained under RD-4(a); the recorded speed bands 4/5 [F10][F11] do not qualify under RD-4(b). The 1.73 km / 979 m deviation is not proportionate to the documented delay and no fact shows the rest of the optimal route was impassable, so the segment is not fully exempted. No consent under RD-5 — the chat [F7][F8] contains no route discussion. RD-2 refund = 1.73 km × $1.41/km = $2.44.

rejected_claims.reason: The full billed excess of $2.90 is not refundable; RD-2 refunds only the unexcused segment's metered distance, and the residual ($2.90 − segment sum) is map-matching residue.
Speed band 4 is not band 1 or 2, so RD-4(b) does not apply on its own.
Tampines Expressway band 5 is not band 1 or 2 and is not on the replaced segment, so RD-4(b) does not apply.
Rider profile facts do not decide any issue in this case.
